description:
Searches the text of one book or one poem for passages about a topic, by meaning rather than exact words, and returns the passages with page and chapter (books) or the line and its neighbours (poems), plus a relevance score.

Use when the user asks to find a passage, a scene, or what a book or poem says about something, in a book or poem already identified by id (from search_books, get_reading_history or get_currently_reading). For the text around the page the reader has reached, without a topic, use get_passages_near_reading_position.

Book text is available only for books the reader uploaded their own copy of in the ReadingRate app; for other books the result says the text is not available. Poems are always searchable.

Spoiler protection is on by default for books: for a book on the reader's want-to-read list no passages are returned, and for a book they are reading only pages up to their logged position are searched. If no position is logged, the whole book is searched, unless spoiler_protection is set to true, in which case passages are withheld and the result says so. Finished books are searched in full. Set spoiler_protection to false to search the whole book.

Examples:
- {"query": "marriage", "book_id": "<book id>"}
- {"query": "the hunt", "poem_id": "whoso-list-to-hunt"}

book_id.description: The book to search: its ReadingRate id or library entry id. Give this or poem_id.

poem_id.description: The poem to search: its anchor or slug, as for get_poem. Give this or book_id.

query.description: What to look for, in words, e.g. "passages about memory"

spoiler_protection.description: Search only pages the reader has reached (default true). With no logged position, true withholds passages and the default searches the whole book. Not used for poems.

name: search_book_content

filtered_to_book.description: Present when book_id was provided: the resolved book

message.description: Present when no passages were found: explains why

slug.description: Always empty (not returned by the search backend)

query.description: The search query that was run

spoiler_protection.description: Present when spoiler protection was applied or explicitly requested

reason.description: Why protection was not applied (e.g. book already finished)

title: Search book content
